Monster Jam Freestyle Mania presented by Spin Master
events.info: Get ready for the event that will change everything you thought you knew about freestyle - Monster Jam Freestyle Mania, presented by Spin Master. Monster Jam® trucks team up with Freestyle Motocross bikes to deliver gravity-defying skills and thrills. We have created one-of-a-kind FMX bikes for this epic team competition, each with the bold, iconic look of your favorite Monster Jam trucks, like the legendary Grave Digger®, El Toro Loco®, Sparkle Smash and more. Cheer for your favorite team as they pull off stunts you have never seen before. The energy, the action, the next-level thrills will keep you on the edge of your seat. It is a high-energy good time and it is only at Monster Jam.
events.pleaseNote: -All guests age 2 & older are required to have a ticket. -No costumes for guests 14 & older. -Please monitor the venue website for venue policies, including health and safety protocols, which are subject to change. -All tickets are subject to availability. -Prices & Competitors are subject to change. -Monster Jam Trackside begins approximately one hour before the event start time and features: o Competition Preview o Driver Interviews o Behind the Scenes with the Pit Crew o Judges Zone Overview o Opening Ceremonies o Giveaways o Power Rush Truck Introductions There?s no better way to get ready for the action, so get to your seats early to experience all the family fun. -Visit MonsterJam.com [monsterjam.com] for more event info and Ticket Terms and Conditions.
